title: Sina Finance reports DeepSeek says its services face large-scale malicious attacks, and a US firm has applied for a 'DeepSeek' trademark
summary: The article names Delaware-based Delson Group as the trademark applicant and notes Nvidia's shares fell 3.67% on 31 January.

title: OpenAI releases deep research, an agent that browses the web to write reports
summary: Entrepreneur describes it as an agent that autonomously browses the web to conduct research.

title: Australia's Home Affairs department directs government bodies to remove DeepSeek products from their systems
summary: Wikipedia's DeepSeek article describes a government-wide directive to prevent use of DeepSeek products.

title: Google releases Gemini 2.0 Pro
summary: The release is part of the February 2025 Gemini model updates.

title: Mistral releases its Le Chat assistant on iOS and Android
summary: Computerworld reports the mobile launch of the French lab's chatbot.

title: France announces EUR 109bn in private AI investment at the Paris AI Action Summit
summary: BBC News reports the pledge as part of the summit on 10 and 11 February.

title: Musk-led consortium bids USD 97.4bn for the nonprofit that controls OpenAI
summary: The Financial Times reported the unsolicited offer; OpenAI rejected it on 14 February.

title: 62 countries, the African Union Commission and the EU sign a Paris summit declaration on inclusive and sustainable AI; the US and UK decline
summary: BBC News reports the declaration at the AI Action Summit.

title: xAI releases Grok 3 and its DeepSearch research agent
summary: TechCrunch reports the new flagship model family includes reasoning variants.

title: Anthropic releases Claude 3.7 Sonnet, a hybrid reasoning model, and the Claude Code command-line tool
summary: Anthropic describes it as its first hybrid reasoning model.

title: More than 1,000 UK musicians release a silent album to protest the government's AI copyright consultation
summary: BBC News reports the protest over the use of copyrighted music to train AI.

title: OpenAI releases GPT-4.5, which it calls its largest chat model to date
summary: The release is announced on OpenAI's site.

title: UAE to invest EUR 30-50bn in a 1-gigawatt AI data centre campus in France, the Elysee says
summary: Macron and UAE President Mohamed bin Zayed agreed a strategic AI partnership covering chips, data centres, talent and data embassies.

title: Saudi minister Al-Swaha announces over USD 14.9bn in AI launches and investments at LEAP 2025
summary: Announcements included USD 1.5bn from Groq with Aramco Digital, a Tencent Cloud region and investments by Google, Salesforce, Databricks and SambaNova.

title: South Korea's privacy regulator PIPC halts new DeepSeek app downloads pending fixes to its data handling
summary: PIPC said DeepSeek admitted it had not adequately considered Korean data protection law, and new downloads were suspended from 15 February.

title: Alibaba says it will invest over RMB 380bn in cloud and AI hardware infrastructure over three years
summary: CEO Wu Yongming said the spending exceeds Alibaba's total for the past decade in this area.

title: Yandex releases YandexGPT-5 Pro and lighter YandexGPT-5-Lite models
summary: A Habr review notes the release and reports insider claims that the Pro model builds on Alibaba's Qwen-2.5.

title: Japan's cabinet approves an AI promotion bill with a PM-led AI Strategy Headquarters and no penalties
summary: The bill lets the government investigate AI cases that harm rights and issue guidance to firms, and was sent to the Diet.
